page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

l.i: est interficere. Hac re cognita Iona-
gerunt, & ad aquas lacus Asphar ca-
lexit Bacchides, die sabbathi venit cum
bellium turbæ præfectum misit ad Na-
bathæos amicos suos, oratum ut liceret
apud eos impedimenta sua, quæ mul-
ta erant deponere. Sed Iambris na-
cere ex Nadabatha, magno cum appa-
ratu, filiam cujusdam de præcipuis Cha-
hannis fratris sui, eò profecti sunt: &

main_text.l: cum tympanis, musicisq;et armis multis, pro.

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the top edge, so the page starts mid-word; read as "est" with the start of the word missing. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept. The name "Nadabatha" is printed with a small gap between "Nadab" and "atha" on the scan. "Iambris" and "Iambrinos" are copied as they appear. The page ends with the catchword "pro" set at the lower right.
